text:
ava_csm: Quick flag 30 - Fireleaf (mid-market) rolled to prod 7 weeks ago. Seats stable but exports/reporting usage dropped ~60% last 2 weeks. CSAT follow-up: 6/10 with note 'missing columns + scheduled exports failing'. Renewal in 28 days. We should run a tight rescue play.

matt_success: Agreed. If we don't act they may ask to downgrade. What's the immediate owner plan?

ava_csm: Proposal: 48h triage call (CS + Support + PM + Eng oncall), 7-day enablement (workshop + KB + recording), 21-day checkpoint before renewal. Owners: Ava = CS lead, Sophie = enablement, Leo = support, Anika (PM) = product contact, Rick (AE) = renewal lead.

sophie_onboard: I can run a 30-min "exports & scheduled jobs" workshop aimed at finance admins. Will record and produce a 1-page recovery plan.

leo_support: Logged ticket #94412 with customer sample CSVs. I'll try reproduce in staging and attach repro steps. Pushing a temp transform script as stopgap.

pm_anika: Product note: we have a backlog item for export schema flex, but no ETA. If repro is simple we can prioritize a small patch. Otherwise expose mitigation + roadmap note to customer.

ava_csm: Minimal triage checklist (to finish in 48h):
```
- Schedule triage call with customer admins + PM + Eng oncall
- Customer uploads 3 sample exports + scheduled job IDs
- Support reproduces missing columns in staging + attaches repro to ticket
- Provide temporary export-transform script + mapping doc
- Push in-app banner linking to office-hours booking
- Run 30-min enablement within 7 days (recorded)
- Weekly health pulse (exports success rate + mini NPS) for 3 weeks
- If no recovery by day 21 -> escalate to AE for credit/downgrade/extended SOW
```

matt_success: For the 21-day checkpoint, define measurable success criteria.

ava_csm: Proposed success criteria: (1) export job success >= 85% OR documented adoption recovery plan with dates; (2) zero open reporting bugs for customer OR customer accepted mitigation; (3) post-training NPS >= 7 OR AE signs off.

ae_rick: If unmet, AE options to present: one-month credit, downgrade to Lite for next billing cycle (with migration help), or paid onboarding hours. We'll decide after the checkpoint.

leo_support: I've attached repro and the temp python snippet to ticket 94412: `python fix_exports.py --map finance_fields`. Marked as high priority.

notif_bot: Ticket 94412 updated by leo_support. SLA requested: triage in 48h.

sophie_onboard: Invite created: Fireleaf - Exports Workshop (in 34 hours). I'll add a 15-min internal sync immediately after to agree AE offer if needed.

ava_csm: I'll draft the in-app banner and the one-page exec recovery summary after triage. Banner copy (draft): "Having trouble with Scheduled Reports? Join a quick workshop to restore exports and get a temporary transform script. Book here: [link]" Will push in 24h.

matt_success: :thumbsup: Please also capture feature-gap list for product and include in renewal notes. Transparency + timeline helps.

pm_anika: Will surface the product backlog items and a realistic ETA to include in the recovery one-pager.

sophie_onboard: Recording and one-pager will be uploaded to the ticket after the workshop.

ava_csm: Thanks team. React with :thumbsup: if you can attend triage.

matt_success: :thumbsup:

sophie_onboard: :thumbsup:

leo_support: :thumbsup:
